recipe.preprocess: the model's training preprocess (448, sigma 4.0 contract)
recipe.box_source: BOUNDING_BOX_OF_DETECTED_CUBOID_CORNERS — DOPE has no box head. YOLO's box is a learned prediction; this one is derived from keypoints.  They are not the same quantity.
recipe.score_source: max belief peak over the 8 cuboid corners.  YOLO uses box confidence.  Both are the model's own presence score but they are not on the same scale.
recipe.reflect_padding_note: plain squash inference systematically under-detects truncated and close-range pallets and would make DOPE look worse than it is
